name: Developer Hub - Source Code Baseline Export

acceptanceGate.path: Settings -> Developer Hub -> Download Source Code
checks: Developer Hub is reachable from Settings on home and session UI
Download Source Code returns a valid ZIP
ZIP contains current TAR working-tree source code
ZIP excludes .env/.env.*, .git, node_modules, logs, screenshots, recordings, backups, caches, build artifacts and temporary files
server performs a high-confidence secret scan before download
no browser-supplied filesystem path is accepted
